_comment: Static card data for the reworked 98-design pool (7 premade 4-4-6 decks). Source of truth: docs/cards/decks/*.md + docs/cards/decks/README.md (decisions A-J) + docs/rules/keywords.md. Effect LOGIC lives in engine code (effects/statics/strength), bound in Phase 2 - NOT here; numeric tunables live in engine/config.py. Schema: id (globally unique snake_case), name, deck (owning deck slug), rarity, tags (flat list of families + roles, [] for tagless), base_strength (int 0-10 or 'dynamic'), dynamic_strength (rule name iff base 'dynamic'; only Goliath/Chameleon), keywords (subset of Flight/Armor/Fragile/Apex Predator; Roar/Deathrattle are text prefixes, not keywords), food_cost (int, only on 'Costs X food' cards), text (verbatim printed text).
